references.text: The men of Sodom were wicked and sinned greatly against the Lord.
The Lord says that the sin of Sodom and Gomorrah is so great that he must go down to see if what they have done is truly as bad as the outcry that has reached him.
A close parallel: While they were enjoying themselves, wicked men from the city surrounded the house, knocked on the door, and demanded that the man who had come in be handed over to them.

See, this was your sister Sodom's sin: Arrogance, an abundance of food, and a carefree life she and her daughters enjoyed, but she did not help the poor and needy. They were proud and committed detestable acts before me.

He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction and made them an example for those who would live ungodly lives. But he rescued righteous Lot, who was distressed by the lawless people's immoral conduct—for the righteous man living among them tormented his righteous soul day after day with their lawless deeds.

Just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities, which similarly indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are set forth as an example by suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
